run_r2d2_atari: run the R2D2 reinforcement learning agent on an Atari environment like Pong using absl flags
build_experiment_config: build an R2D2 experiment configuration with Atari networks and a custom environment factory
run_distributed_experiment: launch a distributed R2D2 experiment with multiple actors using Launchpad and xm docker resources
run_single_threaded_experiment: run a single-threaded R2D2 experiment by setting the run_distributed flag to false
configure_r2d2_agent: configure an R2D2 agent with trace length, learning rate, and replay size parameters
